name: Steigenberger Frankfurter Hof
positioning: Historic grand hotel on Am Kaiserplatz, welcoming guests since 1876, in the heart of Frankfurt's financial district and historical city center; officially named Steigenberger Icon Frankfurter Hof
best_for: Business travelers who want a base in the financial district
Travelers who want a historic city-center hotel with a large spa

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Frankfurt's financial district and historical city center.
The hotel's address is Am Kaiserplatz in Frankfurt.
The central station is about a 13-minute walk from the hotel.
Guests have free access to THE SPA.
The Royal Suite's wellness bathroom has a Finnish sauna, a steam bath and a whirlpool bathtub.
Grand Deluxe Rooms have a marble bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and a bathtub with an integrated flat-screen TV.
Rooms include one complimentary minibar refill per stay.
Facilities include the Autorenbar, the Ehrenhof terrace, the Cigarrum, a barber and a fitness area.
Restaurant Hofgarten serves breakfast, freshly prepared or as a buffet.
Brasserie Moderne OSCAR's serves regional and contemporary menus and snacks.
The hotel has 17 meeting rooms, from salons to a ballroom.

highlights.text: The Royal Suite on the fourth floor has a living room with four French balconies, a private kitchen and a dedicated conference room.
Studio Suites are two-room suites designed by Frankfurt interior designer Bergit Countess Douglas.
Selected Studio Suites have a private terrace with views of the Frankfurt skyline.
The spa is styled in the manner of '1001 Nights'.
The hotel has welcomed guests since 1876.

considerations.text: Parking is in a public parking garage or by valet, and both are chargeable.
Pets are allowed on request for a fee.
WhataHotel notes a busy city-center location with urban noise.
